# Preparing your tax return
## Due dates for your tax return
If you’re lodging your own tax return, you need to lodge it by 31 October each year.

If 31 October falls on a weekend, the due date to lodge your tax return is the next business day after 31 October.

# Income tax return
## Sole traders
### When to lodge
If you're lodging your own your tax return, it is due by **31 October**.

## Partnerships and partners
### When to lodge
If you lodge the partnership tax return yourself, it is due by **31 October**.

## Trusts and beneficiaries
### When to lodge
If you lodge the trust tax return yourself, it is due by **31 October**.

## Companies
### When to lodge
If there are any prior year returns outstanding, the due date will be **31 October**.

# When are tax returns due? Why is my refund so low?
## When are tax returns due?
Usually, people who do their own tax returns must lodge them by October 31.

And [the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) says that](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/before-you-prepare-your-tax-return/preparing-your-tax-return) if October 31 falls on a weekend, the due date is the next business day.
